summary.result: The objective of the research project is to develop the hybrid deodorizer for the removal of residual harmful gases generating during pretreatment process of biogas.
summary.background: This hybrid deodorizer is capable of treating harmful gases that contains hydrogen sulfide (H2S), ammonia (NH3) and other odor substances.
summary.method: These residual harmful gases were effectively removed in the effluent, achieving up to 97% removal of H2S and 94% removal of NH3 after treatment using hybrid deodorizer.
